selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What two truths does the person say while sitting in this part of the prayer?
questions.answer: He declares that Allah is One and that Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, is Allah’s messenger.

questions.question: What does he offer on his own behalf while sitting?
questions.answer: He presents blessings and greetings as a gift to Allah.

questions.question: Why does he send greetings to the Prophet, peace be upon him?
questions.answer: To renew his loyalty to him and show that he follows his teachings.

questions.question: What does he look at in the universe to strengthen his faith?
questions.answer: He reflects on the wise arrangement and order in creation.

questions.question: What does that order in the universe help him recognize?
questions.answer: It helps him affirm that the Maker is One.

questions.question: How is Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, described in relation to Allah’s message?
questions.answer: He is described as the one who announces Allah’s rule, tells what pleases Allah, and explains the signs in creation.

questions.question: Why is the prayer at sunset called a pure and noble duty?
questions.answer: Because it is a beautiful act of worship and service that brings a person close to Allah.

questions.question: What does the passage say this prayer becomes in this temporary world?
questions.answer: It becomes an ongoing talk with Allah and a lasting happiness.

questions.question: In this passage, what does the worshipper confirm first?
questions.answer: Allah’s oneness and the prophethood of Muhammad, peace be upon him.

questions.question: When he is seated, whose greetings and blessings does he offer to Allah?
questions.answer: He offers the blessed salutations and benedictions of all creatures.

questions.question: What does greeting the Prophet, peace be upon him, show about the worshipper?
questions.answer: It shows commitment, love, and obedience.

questions.question: What helps renew and brighten the worshipper’s belief?
questions.answer: Thinking about the careful order of the universe.

questions.question: What does the universe act like in the passage?
questions.answer: It is pictured like a palace.

questions.question: What does the worshipper testify about the Maker after observing creation?
questions.answer: He testifies that the Maker is One.

questions.question: According to the passage, what special role does the Prophet, peace be upon him, have?
questions.answer: He explains Allah’s signs and announces what Allah wants from people.

questions.question: Why does the passage speak strongly about understanding Maghrib prayer?
questions.answer: Because this prayer is presented as a great act of worship, service, and joy, so missing its value shows a serious lack of understanding.

questions.question: What important belief about Allah is stated in this part of the passage?
questions.answer: That Allah has no partner and is the only true God.

questions.question: What important belief about Muhammad, peace be upon him, is stated here?
questions.answer: That he is Allah’s prophet and messenger.

questions.question: What is the worshipper doing when he sits after the movements of prayer?
questions.answer: He is giving greetings and blessings and making his testimony of faith.

questions.question: Why does he offer these greetings and blessings to Allah as a gift?
questions.answer: To honor Allah with worship from his own side.

questions.question: What action shows that the worshipper is still connected to the Prophet, peace be upon him?
questions.answer: He sends greetings to him and renews his pledge to follow him.

questions.question: How does the passage connect belief with thinking about the world?
questions.answer: It teaches that seeing the wisdom and order in the universe strengthens belief.

questions.question: What does the Prophet, peace be upon him, help people understand?
questions.answer: He helps people understand Allah’s signs and what Allah is pleased with.

questions.question: What does the passage say Maghrib prayer can give a person in this passing world?
questions.answer: A lasting joy and a continuing conversation with Allah.
